_comment: Copy this file to squad.json, then add exactly 15 current FPL players before using --squad.
_comment_players: Each item in players must contain player_code and purchase_price. Find player_code in data/2026-2027/players.csv; do not use player_id.
_comment_prices: purchase_price and bank are in millions of pounds, so 7.5 means £7.5m.
_comment_exclusions: Optional player_code values that must never be suggested as picks or transfer-ins.
